samples.xml_description:
<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Converts serial input to parallel output.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data.</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">4'd8</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width="4">Counter to track the number of received serial inputs.</reg>
        <reg id="valid" width="1">Register to store the validity of the output data.</reg>
        <reg id="dout_parallel" width="8">Register to hold the parallel output data.</reg>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk
        always @(posedge clk) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                valid <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (din_valid && cnt == WIDTH - 1) begin
                    cnt <= 4'd0;
                    valid <= 1'b1;
                end else if (din_valid) begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                    valid <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    valid <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Combinational logic to update dout_parallel based on cnt
        always @(*) begin
            if (cnt > 0 && cnt <= WIDTH) begin
                dout_parallel[cnt - 1] = din_serial;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Sequentially receive serial input data and convert it to parallel output.</implementation>
    <task>
        <step>Initialize cnt and valid on reset.</step>
        <step>Update cnt and valid based on din_valid and cnt value.</step>
        <step>Update dout_parallel based on cnt value.</step>
    </task>
</module>
